title: Russian Blockade of Major Ukrainian Ports Threatens Global Grain Supplies

title: Surrogate who refused to abort baby despite biological parents’ request gives birth in Texas
description: McKenna Grace, the Alaskan surrogate who refused to abort the fetus she was carrying despite the biological parents' request, gave birth on Wednesday.
